analisis: Suplemento dietario en cápsulas (nutracéutico) de la marca Vitalabh, con aguaje 200 mg, fenogreco 400 mg y maca negra 200 mg más vitaminas A y E por porción de 2 cápsulas. Frasco de 60 cápsulas: 1 frasco = 1 mes. Se vende como tratamiento de 3 frascos (3 meses) con pago al recibir. Es para mujeres colombianas que quieren más curvas en caderas, cola y piernas sin cirugía. Se ve como un frasco negro mate de boca ancha, con tapa fucsia brillante y franja fucsia abajo; la etiqueta negra dice AGUAJE en blanco gigante y TRIPLE ACCIÓN en fucsia.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. The bottle is always closed with its cap on; no loose capsules, no pills anywhere. The label always reads the right way round, never mirrored.

datos.publico: Mujeres colombianas que quieren glúteos y piernas más firmes y redondos de forma natural, sin ir al gym, ni dietas ni pagar cirugías costosas
datos.adicional: Oferta tomada de la investigación: tratamiento completo de 3 frascos (3 meses), pagas al recibir. Sello del formulario: REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024. Sin precio: no se muestra ningún precio.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent and highlighted headline word), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Offer red #E0242F is used ONLY for offer seals, and seal gold #D4A437 only for the border of the sanitary registration badge. Each variation adds its own secondary support colors from the batch plan.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Bold, feminine supplement ads for Colombian women built on proven winning ad structures; each variation keeps the rendering style of its structure (real phone photo, premium still life, flat illustration or text letter) while the real bottle always stays sharp and identical to the photo, with fuchsia and plum brand accents.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Warm, confident and aspirational but believable and everyday; holiday season warmth (December) where the plan says so; never clinical.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Solid flat color blocks, rounded cards and pills, thin fuchsia borders, white thin-line icons inside circles, hand-drawn curved arrows, high-contrast type readable on a phone. A round badge with a solid gold border for the sanitary registration, a bottom block with 'Pagas al recibir' and the treatment offer, and the same fuchsia pill button 'QUIERO PROBARLO' where the structure carries a button.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look); Poppins Regular for small lines.
identidad_visual.art_direction: Same brand kit across the batch (palette, type, the real closed bottle, the same offer wording letter by letter, the same pill button and the gold-bordered registration badge), but each variation follows a different winning structure, rendering style, body zone, segment, model, wardrobe, camera and secondary palette. One single enemy repeated across the batch: the routine without support (squats and diets alone) versus the 3-month triple-action plan. One message per image. Every person wears jeans or leggings; before/after moments are always the same adult woman on different days (other pose, outfit, hairstyle, place and light). Bodies shown facing the camera or three-quarters, never from behind.
